{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Compute conversion rate for email
total_email = df[df['channel'] == 'email'].shape[0]
converted_email = df[df['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate_email = converted_email / total_email

# Compute conversion rate for paid_search
total_paid_search = df[df['channel'] == 'paid_search'].shape[0]

conversion_rate_paid_search = converted_paid_search / total_paid_search

# Compute the difference in conversion rates
difference = conversion_rate_email - conversion_rate_paid_search

# Print all values to ensure they are captured in evidence
print(f"conversion_rate_email = {conversion_rate_email}")
print(f"conversion_rate_paid_search = {conversion_rate_paid_search}")
print(f"difference = {difference}")"}
